When this router is first cloned to a topology it will not recognize the interfaces on the device. To rectify this you must issue some commands after login. To login use the username vyos and the password P@ssw0rd. then issue the following commands

configure
load /opt/vyatta/etc/config.boot.default
commit
save
exit
reboot


Once the device reboots all interfaces will be visible. The login will be vyos and the password will be vyos.
